messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: Increased 500 error rate for /v1/generate across prod-us-west-2 starting at 2025-06-10T01:20:34Z. Current error rate 18% (SLO breach). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/incident/1750001234

pagerduty-bot: Paging on-call: @Alice Nguyen (primary), escalation to @Ben Ortiz after 15m if no ack.

Alice Nguyen: ack — jumping in. reading logs now, thanks PD.

Ben Ortiz: pinging here too in case we need to rotate. any hint if it's infra or model-level?

Alice Nguyen: initial glance: a spike of CUDA OOMs from runtime-prod-3.* starting 01:19:xx, but also see a small spike in queue latency. grabbing recent deploys.

Carla Mendes: I'm seeing a deploy at 01:18:42 by CI: cd/dx/model-deploy v3.7.9 -> candidate for rollback.

David Li: noting customer impact: multiple requests returning 500s; customer reported timeouts to support (ticket #INC-4021). throttling could be hitting prefix cache as well.

Elena Park: starting mitigation checklist from playbook: 1) disable candidate rollout 2) scale up serving pool 3) enable fallback model variant. Doing 1) now.

Alice Nguyen: disabled rollout for v3.7.9 (flag: feature.model_rollout.v3_7_9=false). Confirmed.

Carla Mendes: rolling rollback to v3.7.8 across prod-us-west-2. Command: `kubectl -n redwood set image deploy/generator generator=registry/redwood/generator:v3.7.8`

Ben Ortiz: while rollback runs, increasing pool replicas + removing max_batch_limit to reduce OOM risk. `svcctl scale runtime-prod-3 --replicas 12`

Alice Nguyen: enabling fallback to smaller quantized variant: `feature.model_variant.fallback=quantized-q4f`.

David Li: customer-facing summary for support: "We experienced elevated 500s due to a recent model rollout; rollback and mitigations in progress. We'll follow up with RCA."

Elena Park: rollback finished at 01:29:02. Error rate dropping to ~2% over last 5m. Monitoring CPU/GPU and queue latencies.

Alice Nguyen: confirming: CUDA OOMs stopped after rollback + scaling. I think v3.7.9 introduced memory-path change that increased KV cache usage.

Ben Ortiz: grabbing heap/dump from a failed pod for offline analysis. `kubectl logs runtime-prod-3-7 -c runtime --since=10m` -> saved as s3://redwood-logs/incident/1750001234/oom-trace.log

Carla Mendes: please patch alerting to suppress repeated pages for the same incident window — small tweak to avoid noise.

pagerduty-bot: Next on-call handoff scheduled 02:00Z to @Ben Ortiz.

Alice Nguyen: handing off to Ben for the post-mitigation observations and postmortem lead. Key facts in handoff: rollback performed, fallback enabled, replicas increased. Error rate returned to normal.

Ben Ortiz: taking over. Thanks Alice. I'll coordinate the postmortem and own the RCA draft.

Jordan (PM): adding product impact notes: two enterprise customers (ACME, Finlytics) reported failed requests. CS alerted them and created remediation tickets. Will track customer follow-up.

Elena Park: quick note for incident timeline: please capture timestamps for deploy, first error, paging, rollback start/end, and handoff. I'll start a rough timeline in the incident board.

David Li: created a calendar event "PM: Incident 1750001234 postmortem" for 2025-06-11 16:00 UTC. Invite: @Ben Ortiz, @Carla Mendes, @Alice Nguyen, @Elena Park, @Jordan (PM).

Ben Ortiz: action items (quick capture):
- AI-1: Investigate memory-path change in v3.7.9 and quantify KV cache growth (owner: Ben Ortiz, due: 2025-06-12).
- AI-2: Add e2e check for model rollout memory metrics before canary (owner: Carla Mendes, due: 2025-06-14).
- AI-3: Update alert thresholds to correlate CUDA OOMs with SLO pages to reduce noise (owner: Alice Nguyen, due: 2025-06-13).
- AI-4: Customer outreach follow-ups and affected request export (owner: Jordan (PM), due: 2025-06-11).
- AI-5: Attach logs and heap dumps to postmortem doc (owner: David Li, due: 2025-06-11).

Carla Mendes: noted. I'll add an automated smoke test for memory usage to the rollout pipeline. Plan: fail canary if 95th percentile memory increase > 10% over baseline.

Alice Nguyen: I'll tweak the alert runbook: add explicit steps to mute noisy PD pages and to escalate to infra if OOMs persist.

Ben Ortiz: RCA drafting plan: I'll create the doc under docs/incidents/1750001234-rca.md and populate timeline + contributing factors. Requesting peer review from @Elena Park and @Carla Mendes by 2025-06-12.

Elena Park: happy to review. I'll focus on monitoring gaps and SLO mapping.

Carla Mendes: I'll review the model onboarding and rollout policy sections.

Jordan (PM): for sign-off, we'll need acceptance from Eng, SRE, and Product. Proposed sign-off deadline: 2025-06-15.

Ben Ortiz: noted. Draft will include: Summary, Impact (customers/requests/SLO delta), Timeline, Contributing factors, Corrective actions (short-term and long-term), Action items table, Follow-ups.

David Li: attaching initial artifacts to the thread (links):
- Heap dump: s3://redwood-logs/incident/1750001234/heap-dump.tgz
- Deploy diff: https://git.redwood.example/changeset/abcd1234
- Grafana snapshot: https://dash.redwood.example/snapshot/err-rate-1750001234

Alice Nguyen: two quick observations for RCA: 1) rollout did not run the new memory e2e, 2) alert correlation rules didn't escalate until SLO breach threshold. Add both as contributing factors.

Ben Ortiz: calling out blameless language here — we're mapping systemic gaps.

Carla Mendes: planning mitigation for long-term: implement pre-rollout memory regression test + per-model memory budgets.

Elena Park: add monitoring: a derived metric for kv-cache-size per model to be included in per-rollout dashboards.

Jordan (PM): I'll prepare customer comms draft after the RCA is available; leave a placeholder in the doc for customer-impact wording.

Ben Ortiz: okay — I'll publish RCA draft by end of day 2025-06-11 (internal) and update thread with link. Peer reviewers: please leave comments inline. After reviewers approve, we'll schedule sign-off meeting if needed.

Alice Nguyen: thanks everyone. quick retrospective note: runbook worked generally well — page routing and rollback performed quickly. Areas: rollout checks and alerting correlation.

Carla Mendes: +1. Also, let's ensure we add a short postmortem checklist item to verify rollback performed cleanly (cache warmup, no stuck requests).

Ben Ortiz: closing mitigation phase — monitoring for 6h. If any regression, escalate. I'll post the RCA link here when ready. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved (status: mitigated). Metrics returning to baseline. Incident severity: Sev2 -> transitioning to post-incident review.

David Li: end of thread notes: next steps assigned; postmortem event scheduled; Ben owning RCA. I'll attach materials to calendar.

Jordan (PM): thanks team. I'll coordinate customer follow-ups once RCA sign-off is complete.

Ben Ortiz: (will update) https://docs.redwood.example/incidents/1750001234-rca.md
